To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) Zee is able to track users with an average error of 3.6m, (b) it achieves 90% accuracy in identifying which hallway a user is in, (c) it achieves 95% accuracy in identifying whether a user is inside or outside a room, and (d), it achieves a mean average error of 2.7m in the final location of the user.
Zee is the first system that enables zero-effort crowdsourced training data for indoor localization.

Zee can localize users with a median accuracy of 2.5 meters and a 95th percentile accuracy of 6.4 meters in a large office environment, using only a map of the building as the only site-specific input.
